english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something very bad or unpleasant, especially something of poor quality.

exampleSentences.english: The food at this restaurant is terrible.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 caa1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something of poor quality or disappointing standard, including something that is inadequate.

exampleSentences.english: This hotel is so lousy, and they still charge so much—it’s outrageous.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間酒店咁差，仲要收咁貴，真係離譜。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 gam3 caa1 zung6 jiu3 sau1 gam3 gwai3 zan1 hai6 lei4 pou2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is very bad or awful, often intensified as 好差.

exampleSentences.english: The food at this restaurant is absolutely dreadful.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係差到不得了。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 caa1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5

english.note: Use 差 when something is very bad, especially a performance or the weather, rather than a person's general misery.

exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 go3 tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 caa1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing low quality or a bad result.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 caa1

english.note: Use 差 for something generally bad or terrible, such as weather or conditions, rather than physically decayed.

exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 caa1

english.note: Use 差 when quality, ability, health, condition, appearance, or an experience is poor.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jing2 soeng2 hou2 caa1

english.note: Use this for something of poor quality or work that shows little ability or effort.

exampleSentences.english: This piece of work is shabby; it’s obvious you didn’t put much effort into it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢份功課做得好差，睇得出你冇乜用心。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 hou2 caa1 tai2 dak1 ceot1 nei5 mou5 mat1 jung6 sam1

english.note: Use this for something poor in quality, bad, disappointing, or generally deplorable rather than emotionally sad.

exampleSentences.english: The service at this restaurant is really sad.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲服務真係差。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 caa1

english.note: Choose this for something very poor or bad, such as a terrible performance.

exampleSentences.english: Their game was painful to watch.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 coeng4 bo1 tek3 dak1 hou2 caa1
